title: Rosemary Beach "Mary Rose" 45 Abaco Lane Carriage House
h1: Rosemary Beach "Mary Rose" 45 Abaco Lane Carriage House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the Rosemary Beach Access and 4 neighborhood pools- Access to fitness center and racquet club- Newly built in 2017 by Benecki Homes and designed by Melanie Turner Interiors- 2 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: This 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom "Mary Rose" carriage house sleeps 2 in Rosemary Beach and is close to both the Racquet Club and beach access. Next to a private pool (the pool is for Main House guest use), you'll find a courtyard stair that leads up to a front porch. Inside is a professionally designed interior with tasteful modern decor and bold artwork. Glass double doors and large windows fill an open-concept living and dining space with natural light. Hone your brunch-making skills in a galley-style kitchen with premium stainless steel appliances, or relax on a luxurious day bed and enjoy the large flat-screen TV. Nestled behind the living space is a bedroom with a king bed and bathroom with shower/tub combo.Feeling adventurous? Discover all that Rosemary Beach has to offer on your 2 included adult bikes. There are 4 neighborhood pools, nature trails, boardwalk systems, boutiques, restaurants, and outdoor sculpture! The possibilities are endless when you stay at the "Mary Rose" carriage house. Don't miss your chance to enjoy all that Rosemary Beach has to offer. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSCARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*The washer and dryer for the carriage house are located in the garage.*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Your rental property may share a courtyard or lot with a carriage house or main house that is owner-occupied or rented to separate guests from your party. Unfortunately, the private pool is for the main house only.
